newsitem.title: USA: Spartech sees higher FY97 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Spartech sees higher FY97 earnings.

text.p: Spartech Corp, which reported higher fiscal second quarter earnings, said Tuesday it expects to report higher earnings for the balance of fiscal 1997.

"Most economists are currently forecasting only two to three percent growth for calendar 1997. However, we remain cautiously optimistic as we look ahead to the next six months and expect Spartech's recent year-to-year favorable comparisons to continue throughout the balance of fiscal 1997," Bradley Buechler, president, said in a statement.
He added that further production efficiencies and improved overall profit margins are expected in the second half of fiscal 1997.

Earlier, Spartech reported earnings for the second quarter ended May 3 of $0.24 a share, up from $0.19 a year earlier. For the first six months of the year, it earned $0.44 a share, up from $0.35 a year ago.

"Strong gains in earnings for both the second quarter and first half of fiscal 1997 were fueled by a combination of improved production efficiencies and the benefits realized from our second half acquisitions of Portage Industries and the Canadian-based Hamelin Group," Buechler said.
